submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native 1254 by 1254 game-map detail square for the original Daoist chibi game 五行奇谈, patch r03_c03 of shared structural tile r09_c11. Use exactly Image 1 framing, scale and coordinates. This shared geometry will be reused for daytime and Spring Festival appearances. Image 1 is a soft regional layout guide with genuine native neighbor pixels in the first 230 pixels on the left and the first 230 pixels at the top. Preserve the shown edge-strip colors, endpoints, contours, paving joints and silhouettes, connecting them naturally into the interior. The x=230 and y=230 guide paste boundaries are not physical scene edges: do not invent a vertical or horizontal stripe, wall, ledge, border or doubled contour there. Reconstruct the soft remaining interior into crisp original painted detail at the same mapped scale. Do not zoom, pan, rotate, reframe, stretch or redesign anything. Content actually visible in this crop: Mostly broad warm ivory-cream bridge paving with sparse long diagonal stone joints. A clipped gray balustrade base and its existing diagonal shadow occupy upper-right; the existing descending pale stair tread/riser edges enter along lower-right, and a clipped near-side rail enters lower-left. Preserve these exact height transitions, joints and shadow endpoints; no plants, water, posts, decorations or new stairs beyond the shown continuation. Only render those visible elements and their existing continuations. Preserve all route widths, height transitions, water and shore boundaries, tree footprints, shadows and structural geometry. Do not import features from another part of the region. Image 2 is the user-confirmed primary painting and material style: bright clean rounded full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy, polished delicate hand-painted materials, soft dimensional highlights, crisp quiet contours and restrained surface variation. Use no UI or text from Image 2. Keep stone stone-colored, foliage green, water turquoise blue and existing surface colors as shown. Add no festival decorations, buildings, planters, trees, lanterns, stairs, circles, medallions, objects, characters, text, frames or watermarks. No photographic texture, plastic look, gritty noise, excessive marbling, cracks, speckles, blur or sharpening halos. Output only the target native square at highest available visual fidelity.
